reasoning_content: The sandbox connection is unstable again. The memory pressure caused by the OOM event is likely the cause. Let's wait and then retry.

action.command: sleep 120; echo "retry $(date +%H:%M:%S)"; for p in 39001 39002 39003; do curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "$p: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:$p/ 2>/dev/null || echo "$p: closed"; done; free -m | sed -n '2p'

tool_call.name: terminal
